description: Pastes text into an agent's terminal and presses Enter, as `vibe_send` does; `submit: false` pastes without it. Text is refused while the agent is on a question unless `force`. An agent asleep, paused or exited is woken or resumed first, and `woke` says so. A Mac sends a Linux host's agents theirs this way, over the link. With `request_id`, the host that types it does so once for that id and agent, for about 10 minutes or until its vibed restarts: a repeat gets how the first went, and a different send with the same id is refused.
